_readme: One provenance entry per researched field of investor.json (COLLECTION.md §11). Each entry carries a `value` mirroring investor.json, which is what the verifier reads.

name.basis: The firm brands itself 'Felicis' on its current site; the registered adviser is FELICIS VENTURES MANAGEMENT COMPANY, LLC and the older sites (and every EDGAR vehicle) use 'Felicis Ventures'.

website.basis: Current domain. The firm's 2005-2010 site was on felicisventures.com; felicis.com belonged to an unrelated owner until about 2010, which is why its 2003-2004 archive captures are a different site entirely.

icon_url.basis: fetched 2026-09-08 by scripts/fetch-investor-icon.ts from https://www.felicis.com/favicon.png: png 256x256, artwork 256px in the source → 189px in the 256px master (0.74x); safe area: artwork scaled 0.740 (box 100%→74%, radius 101%→75%); master 256x256 opaque-plate rgb(20,20,20) opaque=100% box=74% radius=75% contrast=7.0:1 ramp=0.93px

founding_year.basis: Aydin Senkut founded Felicis Ventures in 2006, a year after leaving Google. He had begun angel investing in 2005; the firm's own copyright line on the 2013 site reads 'Copyright © 2006-2013. Felicis Ventures.'

history.value: Felicis was founded in 2006 by Aydin Senkut, an early Google product manager, who invested his own money until the first outside fund closed in 2010. Early bets on Mint, Meraki, Twitch, Shopify, Adyen and Canva built its name. Today its portfolio leans toward AI, including Runway, Supabase and Mercor, and its tenth fund closed at $900M in 2025.
history.basis: Assembled from the run's evidence: six site eras across two domains (felicisventures.com 2006-2010, felicis.com 2011-2026), the ADV (CRD 162301), the ten flagship Form D filings, and the landed base's own distribution. The four-year gap between founding (2006) and the first institutional fund (2010) is corroborated three ways -- press, the absence of any Felicis Ventures I on EDGAR, and the ladder starting at Fund II in 2010 -- and it is the fact behind decisions.md R4, the one open ruling this run raises. Rewritten to the reader-facing shape (PRO-147, 2026-09-24). The stage and country shares (55% seed, 32% Series A; positions in eleven countries outside the US), the full fund ladder ($40M in 2010 to $900M in 2025) and the lead-round details for Canva, Runway, Supabase and Mercor are in the basis above.

investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from its homepage headline (h1, 'Fortune Favors The Brave'), read 2026-09-26; sentence case, straight quotes and a closing period are the only edits. PRO-147: the thesis is the firm's own crisp statement (Erik, 2026-09-26). Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_stage.basis: From the landed entry_stage distribution (Seed 270, Series A 157, Growth 65, Pre-Seed 1) crosswalked into data/taxonomy/stage.json. The firm's own CMS stage vocabulary is exactly this ladder plus a 'Common' value used once.

investment_geo.basis: hq_country on the landed base: US 448 of 493 (91%), then Canada 9, UK 6, Israel 5, Australia 4, Brazil 3, Netherlands 2, France 2, and single rows in Germany, Spain, Finland, Mexico, Singapore, Estonia and Turkey. Core is US; the geo core is capped at two labels by the §1 policy constant and one suffices here.

investment_range.basis: Three legs, per §11. LOWER: the firm's seed cheques, which its own pages describe as first-cheque positions (Periodic Labs' seed, Granza Bio's $7M with YC, Pharos's $5M). MEDIAN $7M is a round-size proxy from the entry rounds the firm and the press state -- Shopify's $7M Series A, Granza's $7M seed, Redactive's $7.5M seed, n8n's $12M Series A, Canva's $15M Series A, Runlayer's $11M seed -- and is flagged as a ROUND-SIZE proxy, fair only for a high-ownership lead investor, which Felicis increasingly is. UPPER: the largest round Felicis has led, Mercor's $350M Series C of October 2025; that is consistent with a 10-15% single-position concentration of the $900M Fund X. Aggregator claims were rejected and are not used.

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first: the names a general reader would recognise first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24). Each is tied to its portfolio row by `slugs`; names read as a reader knows them, without legal suffixes (COLLECTION.md §8). Previously listed (25): Shopify, Adyen, Canva, Notion, Plaid, Cruise, Ring, Fitbit, Credit Karma, Twitch, Meraki, Mint, Guardant Health, Supabase, Runway, Mercor, Crusoe, Poolside, Rovio, Opendoor, Weights & Biases, Flexport, Verkada, Recursion, Planet.

aum.basis: FELICIS VENTURES MANAGEMENT COMPANY, LLC is an EXEMPT REPORTING ADVISER (CRD 162301, SEC 802-74738), so no Item 5.F regulatory AUM exists; §11's sworn substitute is Schedule D Section 7.B. Its private-fund table lists 22 funds with $6,736,794,264 of gross assets, and BOTH range ends are that one sworn number. The table also reaches three vehicles the EDGAR name search cannot -- Clover Fund, L.P., Clover-M LLC and F-LMA L.P. carry no 'Felicis' in their names -- which is the §11 reason the fund sweep is name-swept rather than partner-matched. No press figure above the sworn number is on the record. Note that Clover Fund appearing here settles a trap in golden.json for a better reason than the one it was set with: it was expected out as an unidentifiable fund-shaped name, and the ADV identifies it as one of Felicis's own vehicles -- same verdict, filing-grade basis.

funds.basis: The ten flagship and Focus vehicles, each sized from its own Form D total-offering amount and each carrying the accession the build asserts against. Felicis files a definite offering amount and reports it fully sold, so every size here is filing-grade rather than press-corroborated -- the opposite of Lightspeed's 'Indefinite'/$0 filing style. NOT listed, and counted in this basis instead: the Associates parallel vehicles (VI $2.75M, VII $10.1M, VIII $14.1M, Associates Focus Fund I $7.0M), Side Fund V, the three Community Funds, Clover Fund, Clover-M and F-LMA -- employee, carry and co-investment vehicles rather than fund vintages. There is NO Felicis Ventures I on EDGAR: the 2006-2009 book predates the firm's first institutional fund, which is decisions.md D-T1a.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 2460 Sand Hill Road Suite 100, Menlo Park, CA (FELICIS VENTURES, CRD 162301, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-30). The firm's site names no office in its served pages (3 checked), so the Form ADV stands. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.

sources.source: Form ADV Item 1.F and Schedule D 1.F, FELICIS VENTURES (Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-30)

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 312 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 20 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.
